:::{#exr-matadd-inverse-proof}
#### Proving that a matrix plus its negation is zero

@thm-matadd-inverse says that adding $-\matr{A}$ to a [matrix](#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$ gives the [zero matrix](#def-zero-matrix),
where $-\matr{A}$, the negation of $\matr{A}$, negates every entry,
just as adding $-a$ to a number $a$ gives $0$,
so subtracting $\matr{A}$ undoes adding it.

Prove @thm-matadd-inverse.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Express the $(i, j)$ entry of $\matr{A} + (-\matr{A})$ with @def-matrix-addition,
and use $(-\matr{A})_{ij} = -a_{ij}$ from @thm-matadd-inverse.

:::
